animal_cut_distinction.result: All10 use distinct broad silhouettes or part arrangements: deer low wedge, boar teardrop chop, rabbit paired long cuts, moose broad round bone-in shank, squirrel paired angular nuggets, bear fat slab with3nubs, wolf straight loin, fox curved loin, lynx paired cylindrical medallions, wolverine high joined-lobe shoulder. Species assignment is a design proposal, not anatomical proof or a food-eligibility claim.

processed_state_distinction.result: Reference-derived processed block differs from irregular raw cuts; browned bone-in roast and thin dark jerky differ from raw meat; peach skinned fillet, golden seared whole fish and flattened brown dried fish differ from intact raw fish. Planks show squared layers/wood grain; half-log retains split face and bark; hide is hairless and supple, fur is thick and tufted. Dried meat and planks both use one band around3parts but differ by thin irregular leathery edges, dark meat color, versus squared boards, wood grain and knot.

source_classification_audit.visible_output_findings: Cooker crop supports rounded red/brown block with broad cream cap and orange edge. A016 supports whole golden fish with broad dark roast bands. Fillet, dried forms, cooked game cut and individual species cuts remain proposals.
